test.create_query: CREATE TABLE threshold_top_k_hot ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY () AS SELECT /* 5000 heavy groups (~20 per two-level bucket) carry half of the rows with ~4000 rows each; the rest spreads over ~10M rare groups */ if(number % 2 = 0, intHash64(intDiv(number, 2) % 5000), intHash64(5000 + rand64() % 10000000)) AS k, number AS v, number AS u FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
